service.description: A pay group's prepared period (payrollGroupId, timePeriodId), employment by employment: the employments whose primary pay assignment puts them in the group on a day of it, each with the group's time basis, its hours scheduled, present (attendance), submitted and approved (timesheets) and payable by the basis, paid and unpaid leave, pieces, the claims reserved for payroll (a count), the other stream's difference, what is prepared, what preparing would make or void, its state (ready, blocked, prepared, changed since prepared, nothing to pay) and its problems (an unapproved week, unresolved attendance, a time entry on a worker invoice, time of another employment, a conflicting claim) and notes; with partyRelationshipId, that employment's days, its timesheets, attendance days to resolve, leave requests and inputs. Hours and counts only, never an amount. For a payroll reader of the group's employer, or a manager (PEOPLE_TEAM_VIEW) for their live reports. Refuses anyone else (PERMISSION_DENIED), a group outside the reader's employers (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) and a period not of the group (PERIOD_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: state
parameter.description: ready, blocked, prepared, changed or nothing

parameter.name: employment
parameter.description: The employment asked for: days, timesheets, unresolvedDays, leave, inputs, problems and notes

service.description: A pay group's period prepared (or previewed, which writes nothing and needs only PAYROLL_VIEW): for each employment of it (or of partyRelationshipIds), in its own transaction under its lock, an approved input made once per source entitlement: the worked hours of each day from the group's time basis alone (approved timesheets, or approved attendance: a corrected day or a past day recorded with no flag; the working schedule records none), a time entry's pieces, each working day of approved leave (paid or unpaid as its policy says, in the hours the schedule plans) and an approved expense claim reserved for payroll; an input whose sources changed since (a rate, the hours, a cancelled leave) voided and made again, one finalized left and said. Nothing is made for an employment something blocks: an unapproved week (on the timesheet basis), unresolved attendance (on the attendance basis), a time entry on a worker invoice, time of another employment no entry's employer settles, a claim that conflicts with its reservation, or a source another input holds; each is named and the rest go on. With cutoffDate, an entitlement whose sources changed after it waits for the next preparation. A retry, or preparing again, makes nothing twice. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW and PAYROLL_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED), another employer's group (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a period not of the group (PERIOD_UNAVAILABLE), a group ended before the period (GROUP_ENDED) and a group paying more than 10,000 employees in the period (POPULATION_TOO_LARGE: every employment is prepared, never some in silence). Changes no money.

parameter.name: partyRelationshipIds
parameter.description: Some of the group's employments, comma separated (a list too); all when empty

parameter.name: rows
parameter.description: partyRelationshipId, partyId, personName, outcome (ready, done, repeated, blocked, refused), createdCount, keptCount, voidedCount, reasonCode, message

service.description: A payroll editor's adjustment of an employment of an employer in scope, which waits for a People approval of kind PakPayAdjustment: an amount of an earning or deduction component of the employer with a published term on the date in the pay group's currency (PitAdjustment; recurring with recurThruDate, one dated input in each prepared period through it, at most 24), a recovery of an employee advance's outstanding amount through a deduction (PitAdvanceRecovery, employeeAdvanceId), or the hours or pieces of a day (PitWorked, PitPaidLeave, PitUnpaidLeave, PitPieces, quantity: a worked day's hours are that day's entitlement, so its stream does not pay it again); with correctionOfInputId, a difference to a finalized input of the employment (negative allowed). The date's period must be prepared for the employment's primary pay group. A reason is required. With payrollInputId, a waiting adjustment changed (amount or quantity, component, reason, evidence) and asked for again, or withdrawn (void, with a reason) while not finalized, at its revision (expectedRevision). Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW and PAYROLL_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED), another employer's employment, component or input (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), TYPE_INVALID, REASON_REQUIRED, DATE_OUTSIDE, NO_PAY_GROUP, PERIOD_NOT_PREPARED, KIND_INVALID, COMPONENT_ENDED, COMPONENT_NOT_IN_EFFECT, CURRENCY_MISMATCH, AMOUNT_REQUIRED, AMOUNT_INVALID, QUANTITY_REQUIRED, QUANTITY_INVALID, ENTITLEMENT_PAID (a day already prepared), AMOUNT_OVER_OUTSTANDING, RECURRENCE_INVALID, CORRECTION_INVALID, NOT_ADJUSTMENT, NOT_PROPOSED, NOT_LIVE, INPUT_FINALIZED and REVISION_CHANGED. A retry with operationKey answers the first. Changes no money.

The adjustments of the employers a payroll reader (PAYROLL_VIEW) reads, newest first, by employer, employment, person's name (term), component, group, period or state, or those waiting for the caller's decision (show decide); each with its type, component, date and period, quantity or amount, source (an advance, the input it corrects, its evidence), state, reason, its series' place, its approval and what the caller may do (canDecide, canChange, canWithdraw, canCorrect). Paged. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED) and an employer outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

parameter.name: show
parameter.description: decide: those waiting for the caller's decision

service.description: A decision of the waiting request of an adjustment (payrollInputId: any input of it), by an approver of its step who reads payroll (PAYROLL_VIEW; with no rule the employer's payroll approvers, PAYROLL_APPROVE): approve, or refuse with a reason, through PeopleApprovalServices.record#Decision at the revision asked (sourceRevision, from the notice). The last approval approves every input of the adjustment; a refusal refuses them and frees their entitlement. Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED), another employer's input (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a prepared input (NOT_ADJUSTMENT), one who made or changed it or the person it pays (SELF_APPROVAL), anyone else not an approver of the step (NOT_APPROVER), an adjustment changed since (SOURCE_CHANGED) and a refusal with no reason (REASON_REQUIRED).

The PeoplePayAdjustmentApproval topic's approve service (approve#NotificationMessage calls it as the user): decide#Adjustment approve at the input and revision in the message; refuses a notice of another record (SOURCE_INVALID).

The PeoplePayAdjustmentApproval topic's refuse service (refuse#NotificationMessage calls it as the user, with the reason): decide#Adjustment refuse at the input and revision in the message; refuses a notice of another record (SOURCE_INVALID).

Of the source records named (sourceEntityName and sourceIdList: time entries, attendance days, leave requests, expense claims), those a live pay input consumed and those a finalized one did. For Mantle's writers: a worker invoice (InvoiceServices create#TimeEntryInvoiceItems with RaprVendor) refuses a consumed time entry, and a timesheet whose entries a finalized input paid is not reopened (TimesheetServices get#TimesheetAccess).

A change of source records a pay input consumed (an authorized change of a time entry's rate or hours, its removal, a reopened week, a payroll claim's reservation released): refused when a finalized input paid one (PAY_FINALIZED: a correction pays a difference); an input not finalized is voided with the reason and its entitlement and sources freed, so the next preparation reads them again (a payroll approval of what it read is no longer good). For Mantle's writers, called after their own checks.
